full.description: This image is a photomicrograph of a lymph node tissue sample stained with hematoxylin and eosin. It shows granulomatous inflammation characterized by the presence of numerous foamy histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells. The histiocytes have abundant pale, granular cytoplasm. The histological appearance is characteristic of a mycobacterial infection, such as Mycobacterium avium-intracellulare.

random.description: This is a micrograph showing histological details of a tissue sample, most likely from a lymph node or involved organ. The image displays sheets of large, pale cells with abundant foamy cytoplasm, characteristic of lipid-laden histiocytes or Gaucher cells. The nuclei are generally small and eccentric. The features are consistent with a storage disease such as Gaucher disease.
